title: Malformed SSE payloads are forwarded byte for byte; the gateway neither parses nor repairs them
notes: Three malformed shapes in one body: an SSE event split across two transfer chunks, an event whose data is not valid JSON (a missing colon), and a final unterminated event. An ordinary model egress is byte-transparent: the gateway forwards the chunks in order and raises nothing. client_outcome is unmeasured because the Worker's model-client parser is not covered by any Swift test. The one path that rewrites malformed events is the host-managed credential row (the sensitive SSE sanitizer), out of scope here.
